scope: All P01-P10 followups plus three composed studies
unit: Matched evidence block, exact arm first saves, raw assessments, lineage/retention, fixed-pool views and explicit gates

studies.name: Calibrate evidence and coverage
studies.hypothesis: Readiness gate: exact source, method, fit and lineage anchors permit correctly attributed scoring. This is not a comparative calibration-effect study.
arms: two independent reviewers of twelve diagnostic anchors
studies.failure_or_elimination: Any source/method misbinding, missing unit lineage or unsupported fit category blocks scored launch. Borderline novelty disagreements remain uncertain. No old results rescored.
studies.construction_or_probe_example: Use the known P08 consensus/P08 mapping split, P09 conditional-fit errors, and the omitted P05 household challenge as diagnostic anchors, never fresh confirmation evidence.
studies.case_policy: Primary generation pilot: two fresh matched blocks, one hammer-like design and one analysis-workflow case; confirmation: four fresh heldout blocks, two per domain. I01 uses anchors; I09 uses separately reported diagnostics plus fresh packets; I10/I13 reuse exact paired I06 pools. Reuse across studies is not independent replication.

studies.name: Separate logical inversion from feedback
studies.hypothesis: Challenging necessity and tracing a closing return arrow produce different constructions from a renamed forward chain.
arms: necessity challenge: preserve outcome while removing the assumed tool action
feedback hypothesis: mechanism -> demand -> response -> mechanism
generic creativity: seek a different useful operation or discriminating test, under the same evidence, constraints and two-role budget
metrics: Retention of counterexample and return-edge conditions
studies.failure_or_elimination: No return influence means a partial feedback contract. A logically equivalent contrapositive alone earns no novelty. Reject removal that sacrifices the valued outcome.
studies.construction_or_probe_example: Secure joint is the outcome; ask whether striking is necessary. Separately test whether a hammer-centered joint specification creates further demand for striking. Treat both as hypotheses.
studies.case_policy: Primary generation pilot: two fresh matched blocks, one hammer-like design and one analysis-workflow case; confirmation: four fresh heldout blocks, two per domain. I01 uses anchors; I09 uses separately reported diagnostics plus fresh packets; I10/I13 reuse exact paired I06 pools. Reuse across studies is not independent replication.

studies.name: Make attacks produce options
studies.hypothesis: An explicit constructive obligation yields more usable distinct branches than equally bounded critique alone.
arms: two dependency attacks with critique/testing only
same attack cap, each linked to replacement/removal/test or no viable branch
generic creativity: seek a different useful operation or discriminating test, under the same evidence, constraints and two-role budget
metrics: Saved words and native calls per credited branch
studies.failure_or_elimination: Unlinked attacks, disguised resource relaxation or branches also exposed by critique prevent exclusive credit. Honest no viable branch remains a valid disposition.
studies.construction_or_probe_example: Attack impact-driven assembly, construct a tension/friction or geometry-based candidate, and specify load-direction and slip tests; no physical device is claimed.
studies.case_policy: Primary generation pilot: two fresh matched blocks, one hammer-like design and one analysis-workflow case; confirmation: four fresh heldout blocks, two per domain. I01 uses anchors; I09 uses separately reported diagnostics plus fresh packets; I10/I13 reuse exact paired I06 pools. Reuse across studies is not independent replication.

studies.name: Convert disturbance and move its carrier
studies.hypothesis: Converting a disturbance into a signal and placing the conversion in an artifact may interact rather than merely reassign work.
arms: generic creativity: seek a different useful operation or discriminating test, under the same evidence, constraints and two-role budget
metrics: Factorial production contrast and carrier burden
studies.failure_or_elimination: Stop if the signal needs unspecified resources, the same work is silently moved to a person, or false/cancelling signals lack a test. Missing materials is a feasibility result, not a mechanism success.
studies.construction_or_probe_example: Exact staged quantities make a missing transfer visible as surplus; a layout can carry the counting function. First test one restored bounded batch, with exact starting count and false-signal injection.
studies.case_policy: Primary generation pilot: two fresh matched blocks, one hammer-like design and one analysis-workflow case; confirmation: four fresh heldout blocks, two per domain. I01 uses anchors; I09 uses separately reported diagnostics plus fresh packets; I10/I13 reuse exact paired I06 pools. Reuse across studies is not independent replication.

studies.name: Distinguish coupling from co-presence
studies.hypothesis: A specified interface creates a discriminating joint prediction beyond merely presenting two parent mechanisms.
arms: hybrid with interface scrambled and parent contents preserved
generic creativity: seek a different useful operation or discriminating test, under the same evidence, constraints and two-role budget
metrics: Novelty exclusive of both parent pools
studies.failure_or_elimination: No intact-versus-broken-link distinction means no coupling credit. A production-count factorial contrast does not prove physical synergy; field interaction needs measured outcomes later.
studies.construction_or_probe_example: Preserve accurate records while breaking only the range-to-row link; or preserve two functions of a joint while changing only their force-transfer interface.
studies.case_policy: Primary generation pilot: two fresh matched blocks, one hammer-like design and one analysis-workflow case; confirmation: four fresh heldout blocks, two per domain. I01 uses anchors; I09 uses separately reported diagnostics plus fresh packets; I10/I13 reuse exact paired I06 pools. Reuse across studies is not independent replication.

studies.name: Replicate backcasting without losing the test
studies.hypothesis: Backcasting from a capability yields exclusive enabling probes that retain all decisive disturbances under source-bound compression.
arms: surprising capability -> missing dependencies -> smallest enabling experiment
generic creativity: seek a different useful operation or discriminating test, under the same evidence, constraints and two-role budget
studies.failure_or_elimination: A resource invented to enable the capability, an uninformative cap-only stop, or a lost challenge prevents credited end-to-end novelty. Prior forwarding output is diagnostic, not replication.
studies.construction_or_probe_example: Use the forwarding-route pattern to design a fresh capability under different constraints; include the original mismatch challenge, broken path and unchanged-index rival in the protected test checklist.
studies.case_policy: Primary generation pilot: two fresh matched blocks, one hammer-like design and one analysis-workflow case; confirmation: four fresh heldout blocks, two per domain. I01 uses anchors; I09 uses separately reported diagnostics plus fresh packets; I10/I13 reuse exact paired I06 pools. Reuse across studies is not independent replication.

studies.name: Make anomalies change predictions
studies.hypothesis: Protecting a supplied anomaly changes model discrimination instead of producing two familiar descriptions of the same cause.
arms: ordinary analysis with the same complete observations
protected anomaly plus two explanations for anomaly and normal cases
generic creativity: seek a different useful operation or discriminating test, under the same evidence, constraints and two-role budget
metrics: Discriminator new relative to ordinary archive
studies.failure_or_elimination: Invented anomaly, ignored normal cases or observationally identical rivals fails. Known useful questions are recorded without new-family credit.
studies.construction_or_probe_example: Include a supplied case where the expected organizing action performs worse; compare rival explanations under matched conditions rather than explaining away the exception.
studies.case_policy: Primary generation pilot: two fresh matched blocks, one hammer-like design and one analysis-workflow case; confirmation: four fresh heldout blocks, two per domain. I01 uses anchors; I09 uses separately reported diagnostics plus fresh packets; I10/I13 reuse exact paired I06 pools. Reuse across studies is not independent replication.

studies.name: Compare convergence without method misattribution
studies.hypothesis: Deferred convergence yields sharper feasible probes from identical concern reports than immediate consensus.
arms: defer consensus; opposing predictions before selecting probe
metrics: Unresolved contradiction categories with a fixed counting rule
studies.failure_or_elimination: No consistent advantage across fresh blocks means no method preference. Keep fit uncertainty visible. This changes convergence only, not the entire Robot Talks skill.
studies.construction_or_probe_example: Three independent concerns: beneficiary outcome, operating resources, evidence validity. Compare a stage-transition check with an aggregate error count while counting observation time.
studies.case_policy: Primary generation pilot: two fresh matched blocks, one hammer-like design and one analysis-workflow case; confirmation: four fresh heldout blocks, two per domain. I01 uses anchors; I09 uses separately reported diagnostics plus fresh packets; I10/I13 reuse exact paired I06 pools. Reuse across studies is not independent replication.

studies.name: Repair compression fidelity
studies.hypothesis: Source-bound compression preserves complete tests and caveats without the fit-category and prediction extensions found in old P09.
arms: source-bound compression with explicit protected relation/test/caveat/fit fields and separate proposals
metrics: Relation, discriminator, uncertainty retention per raw ID
Unsupported category or stronger prediction additions
studies.failure_or_elimination: Any unsupported extension fails packet fidelity. Advance repaired compression only if fresh pilot packets contain zero unsupported extensions and complete-retention conjunction is no lower than ordinary. Historical diagnostics are separate regression checks. A tie gives no effectiveness preference; later use may be justified by a separately measured cost advantage. Preserve every failure and raw-ID disposition; new proposal fields cannot receive preservation credit.
studies.construction_or_probe_example: Six pilot packets: two known diagnostic packets (H028 and former K2, now diagnostic), four newly authored untouched packets (two per transfer domain). Report strata separately; confirmation uses four new untouched packets.
studies.review_shards: At most three complete case packets (all three compressor arms) per shard, with two independent reviewers and at most one scalar adjudicator per shard. Pilot and confirmation each have two shards. Capacity is checked on unscored fixtures before freeze.
studies.case_policy: Primary generation pilot: two fresh matched blocks, one hammer-like design and one analysis-workflow case; confirmation: four fresh heldout blocks, two per domain. I01 uses anchors; I09 uses separately reported diagnostics plus fresh packets; I10/I13 reuse exact paired I06 pools. Reuse across studies is not independent replication.

studies.name: Separate exposure from decision value
studies.hypothesis: A qualified alternative slot increases exposure; whether that changes decision quality requires a separately observed decision task.
arms: same locked candidate pool and first choice; distinct qualified second slot or ordinary fallback
metrics: Eligible exposure, entering/displaced scores and contracts
Decision correctness only against an independent task oracle
Decision time, confidence and clarification need
studies.failure_or_elimination: Unresolved ranking keys gate the set. Exposure alone cannot support a decision-benefit claim. No human outcome until participant access, task oracle and consent procedure exist.
studies.construction_or_probe_example: Use ordinary and backcasting pools from the first four consecutive fresh I06 confirmation blocks: eight sets; generic-control outputs remain in I06, excluded by this predeclared exposure contrast. Two deterministic views per set. Optional human pilot: eight participants × four cases =32 decisions; each participant sees one generation-pool/view cell per case. Balance the four generation×view cells twice per case and counterbalance order; nobody sees two versions of the same case.

requirements: Independent frozen task oracle or payoff, before choices
Four different case blocks per person; single pool/view per case; balanced generation×view assignments and order
Fresh confirmation cases require a new upstream I06 confirmation wave; its 36-role ceiling plus wave overhead is separately charged, never free
metrics: Paired-case mean task value difference by view, with participant clustering
Median decision time and clarification burden
human_phase.practical_gate: Prospective pilot-screening judgment: positive mean task-value difference, no increase in constraint violations, and median time increase <=20%; report uncertainty. This threshold is not validated by prior evidence. Pilot/confirmation samples do not imply statistical power or field benefit.

studies.case_policy: Primary generation pilot: two fresh matched blocks, one hammer-like design and one analysis-workflow case; confirmation: four fresh heldout blocks, two per domain. studies.name: Inversion × attack × conversion
studies.hypothesis: The three-stage recipe adds a causal operation or discriminator beyond its single and paired components.
metrics: Qualified raw/final families for all eight cells
Main, pairwise and three-way production contrasts
studies.failure_or_elimination: No gain over simpler cells, lost valued outcome or unsupported intermediary prevents confirmation. An instruction-composition interaction is not evidence of physical efficacy.
studies.construction_or_probe_example: For a secure joint, vary necessity inversion, attack-to-construction and disturbance conversion independently. Three first-save roles per cell; preserve all intermediate lineage.
studies.case_policy: Primary generation pilot: two fresh matched blocks, one hammer-like design and one analysis-workflow case; confirmation: four fresh heldout blocks, two per domain. I01 uses anchors; I09 uses separately reported diagnostics plus fresh packets; I10/I13 reuse exact paired I06 pools. Reuse across studies is not independent replication.

studies.name: Interface × deferred convergence within two lanes
studies.hypothesis: An interface-changing challenger and prediction-preserving convergence interact to produce more informative probes.
studies.failure_or_elimination: All four cells share an incumbent lane and identical fixed concern reports. The study estimates interface × convergence effects within that architecture; it cannot estimate the whole Robot Talks or two-lane effect.
studies.construction_or_probe_example: Per block: one incumbent and three independent fixed concern reports; each of four cells has challenger, convergence and source-bound compression roles. Test the interface conflict by opposed predictions, not a vote.
studies.case_policy: Primary generation pilot: two fresh matched blocks, one hammer-like design and one analysis-workflow case; confirmation: four fresh heldout blocks, two per domain. I01 uses anchors; I09 uses separately reported diagnostics plus fresh packets; I10/I13 reuse exact paired I06 pools. Reuse across studies is not independent replication.

studies.name: Generation × compression × alternative visibility
studies.hypothesis: The full eight-cell generation×compression×view comparison separates creation, preservation and exposure; preservation and exposure may interact in carrying a raw distinction into recommendations.
studies.failure_or_elimination: Do not credit compression/view for raw generation. Null scores or uncertain families gate the relevant comparison. Include consecutive candidate sets with no eligible novelty; do not curate wins.
studies.construction_or_probe_example: Exact paired ordinary/backcasting raw pools and locked raw assessments from I06: two fresh pilot blocks then four fresh confirmation blocks. Each block has four first-save compressors (two generation pools × two compression arms), followed by eight deterministic presentation cells. Upstream generation is charged once to I06. No selection by qualification; include no-opening and gated pools. Exact raw-assessment reuse requires identical raw, rubric, archive, assessed-object and context hashes.
studies.review_shards: Two independent reviewers of at most three complete case blocks per shard; one pilot shard and two confirmation shards. Raw scoring is reused only under exact source/rubric/archive/context identity; new summary retention still receives new dual review.
studies.case_policy: Primary generation pilot: two fresh matched blocks, one hammer-like design and one analysis-workflow case; confirmation: four fresh heldout blocks, two per domain. I01 uses anchors; I09 uses separately reported diagnostics plus fresh packets; I10/I13 reuse exact paired I06 pools. Reuse across studies is not independent replication.

roles: case author blind to study-arm instructions
ordinary-family archive author blind to generated candidates
source/constraint fixture verifier including unscored review-capacity preflight
shared_preparation.reuse_policy: Charge preparation once per selected wave; explicitly document exact reused hashes and reduced actual role counts. Completion audit is distinct from scalar adjudication.

budget_policy: Prospective maxima, not execution receipts. Raw/summary allowances are soft420/350 saved words; review2500 per case-block or <=3-packet shard. No scored retry budget. At most three concurrent helpers. Unscored capacity preflight before freeze: redesign/reshard and explicitly rebudget if full assessments do not fit. Token/internal-call cost remains unknown. Deterministic ranking/validation uses zero model calls. Small samples screen mechanisms, not statistical efficacy. One extra independent completion audit per selected wave, plus six preparation roles, is explicit overhead; optional human support and repeated upstream generation are separately charged.
